name: Air Quality ETL with Anomaly Detection (Open-Meteo + Postgres + Telegram)

parameters.content:
## Air Quality ETL + Anomaly Detection
Extract hourly air quality for your locations from the Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS model data), validate it, upsert it into PostgreSQL, detect anomalies, and report on Telegram.

**Before running:**
1. Run sql/schema.sql on PostgreSQL (it seeds 5 sample locations; edit the `locations` table)
2. Attach credentials: Telegram, Postgres
3. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_ALERT_CHAT_ID` in the Telegram nodes
4. In Workflow Settings set 'Error Workflow' to this workflow
5. Run 'Manual Backfill' once to load 30 days of history (anomaly detection needs about 2 days)

Data: CAMS via Open-Meteo. Free for non-commercial use, attribution required.

### Extract and load
One request per location, 1 per second (rate limiting), 3 tries with a 2 s wait (retry), and a failed location never stops the others. Values outside physical ranges become NULL and are counted. The upsert only touches rows whose values changed, so model revisions are tracked and re-runs are harmless.

### Anomaly detection (in SQL)
1. **threshold**: US AQI at or above the location's alert level
2. **spike**: PM2.5 robust z-score (median and MAD over 7 days) >= 3.5 AND at least 15 ug/m3 above the median
3. **stale_data**: no reading newer than 3 hours (pipeline health)
A 6 hour cooldown per location and type avoids repeats. A higher severity bypasses it.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude, $1::int AS past_days
FROM locations
WHERE enabled
ORDER BY id;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS x(
    location_id int, observed_at timestamptz, pm2_5 numeric, pm10 numeric,
    nitrogen_dioxide numeric, ozone numeric, sulphur_dioxide numeric,
    carbon_monoxide numeric, us_aqi int
  )
),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO readings AS r (location_id, observed_at, pm2_5, pm10, no2, o3, so2, co, us_aqi)
  SELECT location_id, observed_at, pm2_5, pm10, nitrogen_dioxide, ozone, sulphur_dioxide, carbon_monoxide, us_aqi
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT (location_id, observed_at) DO UPDATE SET
    pm2_5 = EXCLUDED.pm2_5, pm10 = EXCLUDED.pm10, no2 = EXCLUDED.no2, o3 = EXCLUDED.o3,
    so2 = EXCLUDED.so2, co = EXCLUDED.co, us_aqi = EXCLUDED.us_aqi, ingested_at = now()
  WHERE (r.pm2_5, r.pm10, r.no2, r.o3, r.so2, r.co, r.us_aqi)
        IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.pm2_5, EXCLUDED.pm10, EXCLUDED.no2, EXCLUDED.o3, EXCLUDED.so2, EXCLUDED.co, EXCLUDED.us_aqi)
  RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
),
counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inserted)::int AS ins,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inserted)::int AS upd
  FROM up
)
INSERT INTO etl_runs (locations_total, locations_failed, rows_received, rows_invalid, rows_inserted, rows_updated, failures)
SELECT $2::int, $3::int, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM input), $4::int, c.ins, c.upd, NULLIF($5::text, '')
FROM counts c
RETURNING id AS run_id, rows_received, rows_inserted, rows_updated;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.location_id) r.location_id, r.observed_at, r.pm2_5, r.us_aqi
  FROM readings r
  JOIN locations l ON l.id = r.location_id AND l.enabled
  ORDER BY r.location_id, r.observed_at DESC
),
hist AS (
  SELECT lt.location_id, r.pm2_5
  FROM latest lt
  JOIN readings r ON r.location_id = lt.location_id
   AND r.observed_at >= lt.observed_at - interval '7 days'
   AND r.observed_at <  lt.observed_at
  WHERE r.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
),
med AS (
  SELECT location_id, COUNT(*) AS n,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pm2_5) AS median
  FROM hist GROUP BY location_id
),
dev AS (
  SELECT h.location_id,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ABS(h.pm2_5 - m.median)) AS mad
  FROM hist h JOIN med m USING (location_id)
  GROUP BY h.location_id
),
cand AS (
  SELECT lo.id AS location_id, lt.observed_at, lt.pm2_5, lt.us_aqi, lo.alert_aqi, m.n, m.median,
         0.6745 * (lt.pm2_5 - m.median) / GREATEST(d.mad, 2.0) AS z
  FROM locations lo
  LEFT JOIN latest lt ON lt.location_id = lo.id
  LEFT JOIN med m ON m.location_id = lo.id
  LEFT JOIN dev d ON d.location_id = lo.id
  WHERE lo.enabled
),
detected AS (
  SELECT location_id, 'threshold'::text AS alert_type,
         CASE WHEN us_aqi >= 301 THEN 'critical' WHEN us_aqi >= 201 THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END AS severity,
         observed_at, us_aqi::numeric AS value, NULL::numeric AS baseline, NULL::numeric AS zscore
  FROM cand
  WHERE us_aqi IS NOT NULL AND us_aqi >= alert_aqi
  UNION ALL
  SELECT location_id, 'spike', CASE WHEN z >= 6 THEN 'high' ELSE 'medium' END,
         observed_at, pm2_5, ROUND(median::numeric, 1), ROUND(z::numeric, 1)
  FROM cand
  WHERE n >= 48 AND pm2_5 IS NOT NULL AND z >= 3.5 AND pm2_5 - median >= 15
  UNION ALL
  SELECT location_id, 'stale_data', 'medium', COALESCE(observed_at, 'epoch'::timestamptz), NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM cand
  WHERE observed_at IS NULL OR observed_at < now() - interval '3 hours'
),
fresh AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM detected d
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM alerts a
    WHERE a.location_id = d.location_id
      AND a.alert_type = d.alert_type
      AND a.created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
      AND CASE a.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
       >= CASE d.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
  )
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO alerts (location_id, alert_type, severity, observed_at, value, baseline, zscore)
  SELECT location_id, alert_type, severity, observed_at, value, baseline, zscore FROM fresh
  ON CONFLICT (location_id, alert_type, observed_at) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, location_id, alert_type, severity, observed_at, value, baseline, zscore
)
SELECT i.id, lo.name, i.alert_type, i.severity, i.observed_at, i.value, i.baseline, i.zscore,
       CASE WHEN i.alert_type = 'threshold' THEN aqi_category(i.value::int) END AS category
FROM ins i
JOIN locations lo ON lo.id = i.location_id
ORDER BY CASE i.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, lo.name;

WITH day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') - interval '1 day' AS d0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT lo.name,
         ROUND(AVG(r.pm2_5), 1) AS avg_pm25,
         ROUND(MAX(r.pm2_5), 1) AS max_pm25,
         MAX(r.us_aqi)          AS max_aqi,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.us_aqi >= lo.alert_aqi) AS hours_over,
         COUNT(r.pm2_5)         AS hours_with_data
  FROM locations lo
  LEFT JOIN readings r
         ON r.location_id = lo.id
        AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') >= (SELECT d0 FROM day)
        AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') <  (SELECT d0 FROM day) + interval '1 day'
  WHERE lo.enabled
  GROUP BY lo.id, lo.name, lo.alert_aqi
)
SELECT (SELECT d0::date FROM day) AS day,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.max_aqi DESC NULLS LAST, s.name) FROM stats s), '[]'::jsonb) AS locations,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM alerts WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS alerts_24h,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM etl_runs WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS runs_24h,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM etl_runs WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND locations_failed > 0) AS runs_with_failures_24h;
